name: Milk Bread
ingredients: Whole wheat flour (Atta) (45%), Protein Blend (8.5%) (Vital Wheat Gluten, Soy Protein Isolate, Pea Protein Concentrate). Sulphurless Sugar, Defatted Soy Flour, (Milk Solids) (27%). Baker's Yeast, Edible vegetable oil (Cold-Pressed Sunflower oil), lodized salt, Fermented wheat flour, Cultured sweet potato and Vitamin C.
